name: binance_all_pairs_spot_1m_exit_and_6h_summary

meta.description: Template n8n workflow: all USDT spot pair scan, 1-minute open-trade exit checks, Telegram trade alerts, 6-hour account summary.

schedules.name: scan_signals
schedules.purpose: Scan all filtered USDT spot pairs for new entries on completed 15m candles

schedules.name: check_open_positions
schedules.purpose: Re-evaluate exits every minute for currently open trades

schedules.name: send_6h_summary
schedules.purpose: Send account performance summary to Telegram every 6 hours

flow: Cron(scan_signals) -> HTTP(Binance exchangeInfo + ticker24hr) -> Code(filter tradable USDT spot symbols) -> SplitInBatches -> HTTP(klines 15m + 1h) -> Code(strategy+entries+exits+risk) -> Postgres(upsert state + events) -> Telegram(trade alerts)
Cron(check_open_positions) -> Postgres(load open positions + latest price) -> Code(exit checks with stop/tp/trailing/time) -> Postgres(update positions + journal closes) -> Telegram(close alerts)
Cron(send_6h_summary) -> Postgres(aggregate account) -> Code(format summary) -> Telegram(summary message)
notes: Use batching (30-50 symbols per batch) to control CPU and API pressure.
Keep per-trade risk small for $100 account; e.g. 0.5%.
